checks.description: A feature root holds only layer modules and the named subpackages
checks.fix: move the module into domain/, providers/, helpers/ or jobs/ (a package with __init__.py)

checks.description: A repository never imports the web framework (no HTTP errors in data access)
checks.fix: return rows or None; the service raises AppError with a catalog code

checks.description: domain/ stays pure: no web framework, ORM, HTTP client or storage SDK
checks.fix: keep the rule pure and pass plain values in; the I/O belongs to a provider or the repository

checks.description: A feature's domain/ never imports a layer above it, its ORM models or its DTOs
checks.fix: invert it: the service imports the domain and maps models or DTOs to domain types

checks.description: No SQL in strings: no sqlalchemy.text, literal_column or string execute()
checks.fix: build the statement with select()/insert()/update()/delete() and bound parameters

checks.description: Business errors are AppError with a catalog code, never a raw HTTPException
checks.fix: raise AppError(ErrorCode.X, details=...) with the code from the error catalog

checks.description: Async all the way: no blocking HTTP client
checks.fix: use the shared httpx.AsyncClient of the provider adapter (with its timeout)

checks.description: Async all the way: no time.sleep in the app
checks.fix: await asyncio.sleep(...), or move the blocking work to run_in_threadpool / asyncio.to_thread
